get_func_params: get a detached copy of a PyTorch module's parameters that require gradient
flatten: flatten a nested dict, list, set, or tuple into a flat list of objects
copy_tensor: clone and detach a PyTorch tensor while preserving its requires_grad setting
recursive_map: recursively apply a function to all elements of a nested list, dict, tuple, or set
recursive_copy_and_cast: recursively copy and move all tensors in a nested structure to a target device
